body.en: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/viscosity-fuel-oils-d_1143.html tractor 4100 vs rural diesel concrete pump Tractor 4100 vs the Rural Diesel Pump The tractor row lists 40 kW under power and a slump of 180–220 mm. The rural diesel lists a 17 kW engine and no slump. The Tractor-Driven 4100 and the rural diesel pump are compact concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. The tractor page lists power 40 kW, output 6–12 m³/h, pressure 15 MPa, distance 40–100 m / 15–45 m and slump 180–220 mm. The rural page lists diesel engine power 17 kW, output 5–8 m³/h, pressure 15 MPa, horizontal 30–50 m and vertical 10–30 m, with no slump cell. Where Tractor-Driven 4100 and Rural diesel pump list different values Theoretical output: Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 6–12 m³/h; Rural diesel pump lists 5–8 m³/h. Hopper capacity: Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 0.25 m³; Rural diesel pump lists 0.2 m³. Dimensions: Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm; Rural diesel pump lists 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm. Total weight: Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 1300 kg; Rural diesel pump lists 800 kg. The same listed value on a shared label: Pumping pressure is 15 MPa on both pages; Max. aggregate size is 1–3 cm on both pages. These are listed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Cells that exist on only one of these pumps Tractor-Driven 4100 lists cells that Rural diesel pump does not: Power 40 kW; Conveying distance (H / V) 40–100 m / 15–45 m; Concrete slump 180–220 mm. Rural diesel pump lists cells that Tractor-Driven 4100 does not: Diesel engine power 17 kW; Horizontal delivery distance 30–50 m; Vertical delivery height 10–30 m. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. How to read the two pages without merging them Both are small diesel-side machines, and only the tractor page lists a slump range. Open /en/products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump/ for Tractor-Driven 4100 and /en/products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump/ for Rural diesel pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price. Does Tractor-Driven 4100 list the same theoretical output as Rural diesel pump? No. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 6–12 m³/h. Rural diesel pump lists 5–8 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other. Does Tractor-Driven 4100 list the same hopper capacity as Rural diesel pump? No. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 0.25 m³. Rural diesel pump lists 0.2 m³. Does Tractor-Driven 4100 list the same dimensions as Rural diesel pump? No. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm. Rural diesel pump lists 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm. Why is power missing on Rural diesel pump? The Rural diesel pump page does not list that label. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 40 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. Tractor-Driven 4100 concrete pump, catalogue comparison, Hebei Pinjin Machinery, Xingtai, Hebei

拖拉机带动4100和农村柴油泵的区别
拖拉机带动4100和农村柴油泵有何不同
拖拉机这一行在功率下印 40 kW，并印坍落度 180–220 mm。
农村柴油泵印 17 kW 发动机，没有坍落度。
拖拉机带动4100和农村柴油泵是河北品锦机械在邢台的紧凑型混凝土泵。
拖拉机页印功率 40 kW、产量 6–12 m³/h、压力 15 MPa、距离 40–100 m / 15–45 m、坍落度 180–220 mm。
农村页印柴油机功率 17 kW、产量 5–8 m³/h、压力 15 MPa、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m，没有坍落度格。
骨料都是 1–3 cm。
拖拉机带动4100和农村柴油泵哪些数值不同
理论输送量：拖拉机带动4100印 6–12 m³/h；农村柴油泵印 5–8 m³/h。
料斗容积：拖拉机带动4100印 0.25 m³；农村柴油泵印 0.2 m³。
外形尺寸：拖拉机带动4100印 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm；农村柴油泵印 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm。
整机重量：拖拉机带动4100印 1300 kg；农村柴油泵印 800 kg。
同一标题下数值相同的有：泵送压力两边都是 15 MPa；最大骨料粒径两边都是 1–3 cm。
以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。
只在其中一台泵上出现的格子
拖拉机带动4100有、农村柴油泵没有的行：功率 40 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 40–100 m / 15–45 m；坍落度 180–220 mm。
农村柴油泵有、拖拉机带动4100没有的行：柴油机功率 17 kW；水平输送距离 30–50 m；垂直输送高度 10–30 m。
缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。
怎样分开阅读这两个页面
两台都在柴油分类里、体量都小，但只有拖拉机页面写了坍落度范围。
看拖拉机带动4100请打开 /zh/products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump/，看农村柴油泵请打开 /zh/products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump/。
河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。
商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。
如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。
拖拉机带动4100和农村柴油泵的理论输送量一样吗？
不一样。
拖拉机带动4100印 6–12 m³/h。
农村柴油泵印 5–8 m³/h。
两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。
拖拉机带动4100和农村柴油泵的料斗容积一样吗？
拖拉机带动4100印 0.25 m³。
农村柴油泵印 0.2 m³。
拖拉机带动4100和农村柴油泵的外形尺寸一样吗？
拖拉机带动4100印 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm。
农村柴油泵印 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm。
为什么农村柴油泵没有功率？
农村柴油泵这一页没有印这个标题。
拖拉机带动4100印的是 40 kW。
缺的格子保持空白。
河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。

question.en: Does Tractor-Driven 4100 list the same theoretical output as Rural diesel pump?
question.zh: 拖拉机带动4100和农村柴油泵的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 6–12 m³/h. Rural diesel pump lists 5–8 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。拖拉机带动4100印 6–12 m³/h。农村柴油泵印 5–8 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

answer.en: No. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 0.25 m³. Rural diesel pump lists 0.2 m³. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。拖拉机带动4100印 0.25 m³。农村柴油泵印 0.2 m³。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

answer.en: No. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm. Rural diesel pump lists 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.

question.en: Why is power missing on Rural diesel pump?
question.zh: 为什么农村柴油泵没有功率？

answer.en: The Rural diesel pump page does not list that label. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 40 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 农村柴油泵这一页没有印这个标题。拖拉机带动4100印的是 40 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
